sara (PM): quick sync — thinking about a 'staging probe' flow for private deploys: allow customers to run a non-disruptive probe pass against their infra and our agents before a full upgrade. want concise launch criteria and a low-downtime plan. who owns what?

nate (Eng): love the idea. a few questions: what exactly counts as a 'probe' vs a canary? can probes touch stateful parts (db migrations)?

joanne (FieldSE): from customers: they want a way to validate network+auth without impacting running tenants. probes should be read-only health checks and config sanity checks. ideally opt-in per-customer.

phil (NetOps): network reality: some customers have strict IP allocation and NATs. probes will fail if we change source IPs or require inbound. we should support both outbound-only probes and an optional webhook-style inbound callback.

nate (Eng): ok — so probes = outbound checks + agent handshake + optional inbound callback. we must guarantee probes never flip traffic or trigger migrations. that means migrations cannot be included in a probe run.

joanne (FieldSE): also request: ability to run probes on a schedule (pre-upgrade weekend run) and a manual "pause" toggle so ops can stop rollout if probe fails.

phil (NetOps): fallback: if probe shows degraded networking, we need an automated rollback route and a way to exclude that customer from the global rollout. suggest per-customer rollout tags and health endpoints: `GET /agent/health?probe=true` and `POST /agent/rollout/pause` (auth via existing key).

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: private-deploy-staging-probe-run #42 queued for 2026-04-01 02:00 UTC (notify: sara, nate, phil) :gear:

sara (PM): draft launch-criteria proposal: 1) probe pass (>=95% checks) on staging infra, 2) no agent handshake errors for 48h post-probe, 3) field sign-off from customer or opt-in flag, 4) rollback path validated in test env. thoughts?

nate (Eng): add: no DB schema changes during probe. if the release includes migration we gate it behind a separate migration window and a migration-run checklist.

joanne (FieldSE): add acceptance item: run probe against a customer's config with their NetOps present once before GA. they treat that as the last-mile test.

phil (NetOps): also require a network playbook (SNAT/DNAT mapping, firewall rules) and a small troubleshooting runbook for common failures.

sara (PM): thanks — next steps: nate to write a short RFC for the probe API + agent health endpoints, phil to draft the network playbook (1 pager), joanne to collect 3 pilot customers for validation, i'll own launch criteria and comms. can we sync next Tue? :calendar:

nate (Eng): will do. i'll include a minimal curl check example and a probe payload schema. quick snippet i'll put in the RFC: ```sh
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' https://agent.example.local/agent/health?probe=true
```

joanne (FieldSE): noted. i'll ping pilot customers and add any special IPAM notes.

phil (NetOps): will draft playbook and list known NAT caveats. if we can, i'd like a quick lab test against one customer's edge before broad rollout.

sara (PM): perfect — assigned. i'll put a short checklist in the shared drive and reopen thread once RFCs are linked. :white_check_mark:
